name: MiniMax
description: MiniMax language-model API with OpenAI-compatible chat completions, multimodal inputs, reasoning, function calling, and account-aware model discovery.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: MiniMax API Key
credential_fields.description: Create a pay-as-you-go API key in the MiniMax Developer Platform account console.

tools.name: chat_completion
tools.description: Create an OpenAI-compatible MiniMax chat completion. Supports text and model-dependent image/video inputs, reasoning controls, structured output, and function calling.

model.description: Native MiniMax model ID. Use list_models to discover models available to this account.

messages.description: Conversation messages in OpenAI chat format. Content may be text or model-supported text, image_url, and video_url parts.

max_completion_tokens.description: Maximum generated tokens, including reasoning tokens where applicable.

max_tokens.description: Legacy OpenAI-compatible output-token limit. Prefer max_completion_tokens.

tool_choice.description: OpenAI-compatible tool selection mode or a specific function selection.

response_format.description: Requested text, JSON object, or JSON schema response format when supported by the selected model.

tools.name: list_models
tools.description: List MiniMax models available to the connected account in OpenAI-compatible model-list format.

tools.name: get_model
tools.description: Retrieve metadata for one MiniMax model.
